overall: The AG found the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by holding its February 15 meeting in a non-ADA-accessible annex; it found no violation on notice, removal of a disruptive attendee, or post-meeting deliberation, and declined the untimely February 26 complaint.

allegations.summary: Complaint that the chair secured members' permission to respond to a pending OML complaint without discussing its merits in open session at the January 25 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Because the full complaint was not served with the Commission until February 26, 32 days after the alleged violation, it is untimely and we decline to review it.

allegations.summary: Complaint that the notice of the January 25 meeting was insufficiently specific.
allegations.key_passage: Because the full complaint was not served with the Commission until February 26, 32 days after the alleged violation, it is untimely and we decline to review it.

allegations.summary: Complaint that the newspaper legal notice for the February 15 meeting listed the wrong location (police station conference room) rather than the library annex.
allegations.key_passage: Because notice of the February 15 meeting, as posted 48 hours in advance of the meeting at the Town's official posting location, complied with the Open Meeting Law, we find no violation relative to notice.

allegations.summary: Complaint that the February 15 meeting location, the Library Annex, was not ADA accessible.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Library Annex was not compliant with the ADA, the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law when it held its February 15 meeting there.

allegations.summary: Complaint that the complainant was improperly removed from the February 15 meeting after interrupting it.
allegations.key_passage: Second, under the circumstances, we find that the Chair acted within his discretion when he had the complainant removed from the meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint that commissioners deliberated as a quorum after the February 15 meeting was adjourned.
allegations.key_passage: Because we are unable to determine, based on the available evidence, whether commissioners participated in this brief exchange, we find no violation.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of intent to violate.
remedy_passage: We order the Commission's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution that a determination by our office of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
